What if children with supernatural powers were kidnapped by a secret organization?
And the reason was even more terrifying!
Twelve-year-old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped after his parents are murdered. He wakes up inside a secret facility called the Institute!
Inside, children with telepathy and telekinesis undergo horrifying experiments. But the biggest mystery is the Back Half, where children disappear and never return!
Here's the twist! The Institute uses these children as psychic weapons to eliminate people predicted to cause future disasters! But what if those predictions are wrong?
Luke escapes and gets help! The children fight back, but young Avery sacrifices himself. The Institute falls, revealing a terrible cost for a future nobody could guarantee!
They sacrificed children for a prediction?
Was it worth it? Follow Plot Twist With R and A!
